description: Defines the API for database operations in the USP (User Services Platform) system, including initialization, parameter access, transaction management, and data dumping.

methods.name: DATABASE_Init
methods.description: Initializes the database with the specified file.

methods.name: DATABASE_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and releases database resources.

methods.name: DATABASE_PerformFactoryReset_ControllerInitiated
methods.description: Performs a factory reset initiated by the controller.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetParameterValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter from the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_SetParameterValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified parameter in the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_DeleteParameter
methods.description: Deletes a specified parameter from the database.

methods.name: DATABASE_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the database for debugging.

methods.name: DATABASE_ReadDataModelInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Reads data model instance numbers, optionally removing unknown parameters.

methods.name: DATABASE_GetMigratedHash
methods.description: Retrieves the migrated hash for a given hash.
